paragraphs.text: Kasimir , called the Lone Wolf , was a hermit living on the island of Kusho on Dominaria . His real name was Shasido Mayasi .

Kasimir was a wild man, smeared with dirt and dressed in skins, but who was almost a giant , even taller and broader than Gosta Dirk . His head looked even bigger for the shaggy mane of gray hair he sported. His hair and beard were so unkempt that it was difficult to determine that he was human , and his eyes glowed an unholy green, adding to the feral look. He growled like an animal and hefted his two-headed battle-axe with both oaken arms, muscles bulging and rippling under his furry cape. He wore huge spiked gauntlets of silver that covered his forearm from his elbow down to his wrist. A matching sword and scabbard hung at his waist.

Born Shasido Mayasi, Kasimir used to be a general in the kentsu but wanted to be the imperial champion instead. When that position became vacant, he was ordered by a higher general, to travel to the Imperial Shrine and meet Tetsuo Umezawa , who also wanted the job. They dueled and Tetsuo was victorious. Kasimir didn't want to live in disgrace and chose exile instead. Tetsuo promised to keep his birth name a secret within the Empire of Madara .

On Kusho, Kasimir allied himself with Gosta Dirk , a powerful warrior and wizard who acted as the island's leader in times of crisis. During Madara-Edemi War , when Lady Caleria rallied the Edemi Islands against Madara, several counterattacks were made by the empire, and Kasimir acted as Kusho's guardian, even fighting Tetsuo again.

When the monsters and assassins that Ramses Overdark had sent couldn't conquer the Edemis, Emperor Nicol Bolas sent the kentsu to do it. Again Kasimir defended the island, but he was beaten in combat, by none other than Marhault Elsdragon , the leading general of the kentsu. Kasimir was grievously wounded, for Elsdragon had blasted a hole through his torso. He survived nonetheless, thanks to the healing water of Kusho and Ragnar 's healing abilities.

After that Kasimir was seen guarding Gosta, who had fallen ill after Halfdane poisoned the mana of Kusho. The hermit nearly killed himself fighting the shapeshifter , but again the healing waters saved him. The last time Kasimir appeared was when he brought Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki the message that they should get off Kusho as soon as they had killed Halfdane. Presumably, he continued to be Kusho's greatest defender and might have been part of the group Lady Caleria rallied to extract reparations from Madara.
